blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY-The vehicle of a 38-year-old Abulug town councilor in Cagayan was stolen on Monday but was recovered from four suspected carjackers on the same day in Santa Fe town in Nueva Vizcaya, police said on Tuesday. The car belonging to town councilor Carlo Vinagrera, 38, of Libertad village was taken by four men along the national road in Amulung on Monday morning, said Police Major Sharon Mallillin, Cagayan Valley regional police information officer. The four sped off with the stolen car and a second vehicle but were intercepted at the border checkpoint in Santa Fe. READ: HPG nabs 3 suspects, […]...
